completeDesc.cn: 探测信标是一种用于记录侵蚀读数的特殊设备，具有在普通侵蚀中持续收集信息的能力，但无法直接对抗侵蚀潮。
completeDesc.en: The detection beacon is a special device for logging Blight readings and can provide constant data gathering in normal Blighted environments. However, it is incapable of withstanding a Blight Tide directly.

desc.cn: 一处被侵蚀潮损坏的探测信标。需要收集信标当前的状态信息，协助天师府学院进行研究与改进工作。
desc.en: There is a detection beacon damaged by the Blight Tide. An update to the beacon's current status is required. Help the Tianshi Bureau Academy perform its research and improvement tasks.

name.en: Beacon Damaged in the Blight Tide

shotTargetName.cn: 拍摄侵蚀潮中损坏的信标
shotTargetName.en: Photograph the beacon damaged in the Blight Tide

completeDesc.cn: 吐虫长股兽以发光虫类为食，它同时拥有用以消化食物的胃与用以储存的囊，必要时可以将囊中的虫类吐出。
completeDesc.en: The bugspitting lankybeast feeds on glowing bugs. In addition to a stomach for digesting food, it also has a crop for storing extra bugs it caught. If necessary, it could regurgitate bugs from its crop.

desc.cn: 吐虫长股兽会吐出发光的飞虫。需要进行信息收集，协助天师府学院研究吐虫长股兽的生理结构。
desc.en: Bugspitting lankybeasts can spit glowing bugs. More information is required about these creatures to help the Tianshi Bureau Academy learn more about their anatomy and physiology.

name.cn: 肚子鼓气后发光的吐虫长股兽

shotTargetName.cn: 拍摄肚子鼓气后发光的吐虫长股兽
shotTargetName.en: Photograph an Inflated and Glowing Bugspitting Lankybeast

completeDesc.cn: 在武陵的生态农业中，人工养殖的黑腹雉羽兽会被放入田里散养，这会对土壤质量、作物产量产生有利影响。
completeDesc.en: Wuling eco-farming often includes raising free-roam sable-chested fowlbeasts in the crop fields. Such integration exerts a positive influence over soil quality and crop yields.

desc.cn: 黑腹雉羽兽普遍采用人工养殖的方式。需要收集它们在田中的状态信息，协助天师府学院对当前田兽共作模式的研究评估。
desc.en: The sable-chested fowlbeast is commonly raised in farms. The Tianshi Bureau Academy needs field data of their activities to study the effectiveness of the current integrated cropland-fowlbeast farming approach.

name.cn: 东张西望的黑腹雉羽兽

shotTargetName.cn: 拍摄农田中东张西望的黑腹雉羽兽
shotTargetName.en: Photograph an Observant Sable-chested Fowlbeast in the Field

completeDesc.cn: 储备站是从武陵城前往清波寨外围区域时所能见到的第一个建筑，也因此，储备站的报告往往会附带有其周边生态环境报告。
completeDesc.en: The Field Logistics Depot is the first facility people see when they head out from Wuling City towards the outskirts of Qingbo Stockade. Reports from the Depot usually include details about the local ecology.

desc.cn: 根据从储备站递交的报告，储备站周边生态环境遭到了破坏，但具体情况未知。需要进行信息收集，协助天师府学院进行调查。
desc.en: Reports submitted by the Field Logistics Depot described damages to the ecology around the facility. The Tianshi Bureau Academy needs field data to investigate.

name.cn: 储备站周围的生态环境
name.en: Ecology Near the Field Logistics Depot

shotTargetName.cn: 拍摄储备站周围的生态环境
shotTargetName.en: Photograph the ecology near the Field Logistics Depot

completeDesc.cn: 水灯虫刺激性体液的前体分别储藏在了两个独立的腺体中，混合反应后才生成刺激性体液，有效避免体内损伤。
completeDesc.en: Waterlamps store precursors of their fluid irritant within two separate glands. These precursors would undergo a reaction to create the fluid irritant while avoiding internal damages.

desc.cn: 水灯虫是一种水栖昆虫。需要收集水灯虫露出腹腔时的影像信息，协助天师府学院对它的生理结构进行研究。
desc.en: Waterlamps are aquatic insects. The Tianshi Bureau Academy needs photographic data of waterlamps exposing their abdomens to help study its physiological structure.

completeDesc.cn: 枢壤仪是集合了天师们心血的产物，体积不大，但使用它需要消耗大量息壤。
completeDesc.en: The Tianshi spent countless hours and effort to create the Xiranite Nexus. However, a huge amount of Xiranite is required to use this device.

desc.cn: 枢壤仪项目进展顺利。需要收集枢壤仪当前的状态数据，反馈给天师府学院，帮助其继续进行项目完善工作。
desc.en: The Xiranite Nexus project is progressing smoothly. Collect data of its current status and share it with the Tianshi Bureau Academy. This will help the Academy carry out the project to its completion.

completeDesc.cn: 这类小型水车在某种程度上似乎起到了增氧的作用。
completeDesc.en: Small waterwheels like these can help oxygenate the water.

desc.cn: 清波寨的水车有利于水中鳞兽的栖息繁衍，请将它的运作状态拍摄下来，以便学生们研究学习。
desc.en: The waterwheels of Qingbo Stockade provide habitats conducive for local populations of aquatic fins. Please photograph a working waterwheel for the disciples to study and learn from.

completeDesc.cn: 小壳兽缩进壳内是一种自我保护的行为，当出现比它大的生物时，就会缩进壳里。且不会发出仅相机能捕捉的光。
completeDesc.en: A mini shellbeast protects itself by withdrawing into its shell, and it usually does this when it sees an organism larger than itself. Also, this action does not emit any light that could only be captured with a camera.

desc.cn: 有传言称，当小壳兽因靠近而缩进壳里时，它会发出仅用相机才能捕捉到的光，请协助宏山科学院验证这一现象。
desc.en: Rumors say that when a mini shellbeast adopts its defensive posture and withdraws into its shell, it emits a glow that could only be captured with a camera. Hongshan Academy of Sciences needs someone who can help verify this claim.

shotTargetName.cn: 拍摄缩进壳中的小壳兽

completeDesc.cn: 蓄水源石虫往往成群出现在富水环境下，并表现出较强的活力。
completeDesc.en: Cistern Originium Slugs usually exist in groups in places with abundant water and tend to be unusually active.

desc.cn: 蓄水源石虫在不同生态环境下，或独行或群聚。需要进行信息收集，协助天师府学院完善对这一现象的研究。
desc.en: Cistern Originium Slugs either live independently or in groups depending on the local ecology or environment. Additional information is required by the Tianshi Bureau Academy to learn more about such phenomena.

shotTargetName.en: Photograph a group of Cistern Originium Slugs

completeDesc.cn: 早期的动力竹筏会惊扰到水中的生物，随着调试器的覆盖普及，包括七彩鳞在内的水生生物恢复到了原有的规模。
completeDesc.en: Early powered rafts tend to disturb the aquatic wildlife. However, as modulators become more popular, the population of many aquatic organisms, including rainbow fins, have rebounded to their original sizes.

desc.cn: 动力竹筏上装有避免惊扰水中生物的调试器。需要收集动力竹筏行驶时七彩鳞的反应，协助天师府学院改进调试器。
desc.en: Powered bamboo rafts have been furnished with modulators to avoid disturbing aquatic organisms. Actual responses by rainbow fins towards a working bamboo raft are still required to help the Tianshi Bureau Academy make improvements to the modulators.

shotTargetName.en: Photograph the rainbow fin in the water

completeDesc.cn: 设立室内试验田是为了挑选出更适宜在人造环境中种植的苗株，满足在极端环境种植作物的需要。
completeDesc.en: The aim of setting up the indoor testing plot is to select plant varieties that grow better in artificial environments and identify crop cultivars capable of growing in extreme environments.

desc.cn: 室内试验田的观测设备因维修无法使用。需要收集试验田作物的当前状态信息，协助天师府学院进行数据分析。
desc.en: The indoor testing plot video cameras are down for maintenance. Gather information on the current status of the test plots to help the Tianshi Bureau Academy analyze their data.

completeDesc.cn: 这棵古树在观测站建成前便已经存在于这片小水潭上，它本身构成的微生态系统可以反映当地受侵蚀影响的程度。
completeDesc.en: This ancient tree has been growing in this tiny pond even before the monitoring center was built. The mini-ecosystem it sustains can help reflect the levels of local Blight.

desc.cn: 古树最近发出了一些很奇怪的声响。需要进行信息收集，协助观测站对该区域进行生态监测。
desc.en: Strange noises have been recently heard near the Ancient Tree. More information is required to help the monitoring center keep track of the local ecology.

shotTargetName.cn: 拍摄生长在小水潭上的古树
shotTargetName.en: Photograph the ancient tree in the small lake

completeDesc.cn: 随着新天师桩的部署，一些位置已不再关键的天师桩会被放弃，若不对当地生态造成影响便不会考虑搬移。
completeDesc.en: As new Tianshi Pillars are deployed, older structures no longer at critical locations would be abandoned. They would only be removed if they exert undesirable influences to the local ecosystem.

desc.cn: 一个被弃用的天师桩。需要收集生长在倒塌天师桩上的植被信息，协助对“是否有必要搬移倒塌天师桩”的调查评估。
desc.en: There is an abandoned Tianshi Pillar. Information is required about epiphytes growing on the collapsed structure to help determine the "necessity in removing the collapsed Tianshi Pillar".

completeDesc.cn: 关于先有树还是先有亭的争论从未停止，但唯一可以确认的是，这棵树承载了许许多多武陵人的过往记忆。
completeDesc.en: People are still arguing which of these came first, the tree or the pavilion. But one thing remains true: The tree is a centerpiece in the memories of many Wulingers.

desc.cn: 一棵长在亭子中间，有着粉色叶子的树木。需要进行信息收集，协助观测站对“栖霞驻影”突然大量落叶的调查。
desc.en: There is a pink-leafed tree growing in a certain pavilion. More information is needed to help the monitoring center determine the cause behind the sudden leaf drop of the "Eternal Sunset".

shotTargetName.cn: 拍摄生长在亭子中间的“栖霞驻影”
shotTargetName.en: Photograph the "Eternal Sunset" growing in the middle of the pavilion

completeDesc.cn: 传说曾有一位天师，在这里悟出自己技艺的本真后，将一颗种子放入石壁，承载这段过往的种子，便是“漱玉”。
completeDesc.en: Legend speaks of a Tianshi who attained the ultimate truth of his technical arts in this location. He then planted a seed into the stone wall. Being a vessel of the past, the seed later grew and became the "Cleansing Jade".

desc.cn: 一棵长在石柱侧面，有着白色叶子的树木。需要进行信息收集，协助观测站对“‘漱玉’是否会垮塌”进行的调查。
desc.en: There is a white-leafed tree growing from the sides of a stone pillar. More information is required to help the monitoring center determine if "the 'Cleansing Jade' is falling off".

shotTargetName.cn: 拍摄在石柱上侧向生长的“漱玉”
shotTargetName.en: Photograph the "Cleansing Jade" growing out of a pillar

completeDesc.cn: 蓄水源石虫在脱离水源一段时间后，会快速脱水，新陈代谢近乎停止，以此达到减少体内水分消耗的效果。
completeDesc.en: When removed from a source of water, Cistern Originium Slugs rapidly dehydrate. Their metabolic rates would grind to a literal halt to minimize further loss of water from their bodies

desc.cn: 蓄水源石虫在充满活力时会做出一些摇头晃脑的动作，但没有影像留存。需要收集影像资料，协助天师府学院完善记录。
desc.en: When filled with vigor, Cistern Originium Slugs are said to actively shake and bob their heads. To date, we still have zero photographic evidence that proves this behavior. Help the Tianshi Bureau Academy document this activity and complete our records.

name.cn: 充满活力的蓄水源石虫

shotTargetName.cn: 拍摄充满活力的蓄水源石虫
shotTargetName.en: Photograph a Vigorous Cistern Originium Slug

completeDesc.cn: 经检测，祖泉附近水质正常，但不排除后续产生变化的可能性，已加入重点监测名单。
completeDesc.en: Analysis revealed that water quality near the Ancestral Spring is still normal, but we cannot rule out the possibility of changes in the future. The site has been added to the list of key monitoring targets.

desc.cn: 祖泉附近的战斗或许会对环形瀑布造成影响。出于安全考虑，请拍下它的现状，帮助天师府学院完成分析。
desc.en: The battle near the Ancestral Spring may have affected the structure of the local annular waterfall. For safety considerations, please photograph its current state so that the Tianshi Bureau Academy can complete its analysis.

shotTargetName.cn: 拍摄祖泉周边的环形瀑布

completeDesc.cn: 观测站的工作人员大多会在记录数据或拍照的同时，探望仍独居在树下的孩子，过去如此，未来亦如此。
completeDesc.en: While making data records and taking photographs, monitoring center personnel will also visit the child who lives under the tree on her own. This is a tradition we will continue.

desc.cn: 种下这棵桃树的人们，已为武陵献出了自己的生命。请拍摄桃树的现状，交由观测站记录。
desc.en: The people who planted and nurtured the tree gave their lives for Wuling. Please photograph the peach tree so that the monitoring center can record its current state.

shotTargetName.en: Photo: Peach Tree at Babbles's Home

completeDesc.cn: 经分析，部分单元短路导致每天凌晨时其所控制的水体会出现异常的升温状况，现已解决。
completeDesc.en: Our analysis revealed that the abnormal increases in water temperature that occur every day at dawn are caused by a number of shorting components. The issue has been fixed.

desc.cn: 城建馆附近的水体出现了温度异常现象。请拍摄温控装置，交由观测站分析。
desc.en: Abnormal temperature readings have been detected at water bodies near the Urban Development Hall. Please photograph the water temperature controller so that the monitoring center can analyze it.

completeDesc.cn: 雨水腐蚀了部分电路，观测站已通知天师进行维修。那些刻下的名字代表着功绩与牺牲，武陵必须保护好它们。
completeDesc.en: Parts of the circuitry have been corroded by rain. The monitoring center has informed the relevant Tianshi to conduct repairs. The names inscribed at this location are records of valor and sacrifice. Wuling must protect them well.

desc.cn: 长时间的雨打风吹似乎让安思园天师桩出现了一些故障。请拍摄安思园的天师桩，交由观测站分析。
desc.en: Extended exposure to the elements has caused the Serenity Garden Tianshi Pillar to malfunction. Please photograph this facility so that the monitoring center can analyze it.

completeDesc.cn: 山洞内阶梯感的布置确有人工痕迹，但与水质净化无明显关联，研究将继续进行。
completeDesc.en: Though there are signs that the staircase-shaped rock formations within the cave are artificial, there is no significant correlation with water quality or purification. Our research shall continue.

desc.cn: 清波寨古书中关于净水的模糊记录，不知是否与阶梯状石台及水竹铃有关。请拍下水竹铃，协助观测站完成分析。
desc.en: Ancient records and writings from Qingbo Stockade include vague mentions of water purification. The staircase-shaped stone formation and bamboo water chimes may provide more leads. Please photograph the bamboo water chimes to help the monitoring center complete its analysis.

completeDesc.cn: 枯枝周边深度读数与预期相符，可暂时排除有关异常枯萎的推测，但仍需重点观察。
completeDesc.en: Depth readings near the withered branches are within expected values. Although our postulations of abnormal desiccation and senescence can be ruled out, these branches must be added to our list of key monitoring targets.

desc.cn: 阮一的枯枝可能导致祖泉周边植物进入异常的枯萎状态，请拍摄枯枝与其周边景象，协助观测站进行环境监测。
desc.en: The withered branches created by Ruan Yi may have caused anomalous desiccation and senescence of flora near the Ancestral Spring. Please photograph the withered branches and include the immediate surroundings in the shot to help the monitoring center analyze the local environment.

completeDesc.cn: “我们已对写生者进行了严肃批评。”
completeDesc.en: "We have issued a severe reprimand to the sketcher."

desc.cn: 某位写生者称自己发现了谜之危险生物存在的证据，请将其拍摄下来，观测站将调查这一生物的来龙去脉。
desc.en: A sketcher has claimed to have found evidence of a mysterious and potentially dangerous cryptid. Please photograph this evidence so that the monitoring center can investigate the true identity and origins of this creature.

completeDesc.cn: 旧树生机勃勃，武陵春光尚好，天下喜乐莫过于此。
completeDesc.en: The old tree remains strong and hale. Vernal spring still shines upon Wuling. Such is the epitome of worldly joy.

desc.cn: 它移植自北部禁区，从十年前的事故开始见证了太多悲欢离合，观测站会定期确认其生长状况，请协助拍摄。
desc.en: This particular tree once grew in the North Wuling Exclusion Zone. After being transplanted to its current location ten years ago, it has witnessed many events ranging from the joyful to the tragic. The monitoring center regularly assesses its growth, so please help take a photograph of it.

completeDesc.cn: 经确认，垂藤的过度生长状况是蓄水站水温异常导致的，故障的温控单元现已修复完毕。
completeDesc.en: Our analysis confirms that the excessive growth of the vines is caused by abnormal water temperatures at the Reservoir Station. The malfunctioning temperature controller has been repaired.

desc.cn: 关注到蓄水站顶部的垂藤近日出现了过度生长的问题，请拍下它的现状，交由观测站分析。
desc.en: The hanging vines atop the Reservoir Station seem to exhibit signs of excessive growth. Please photograph its current state so that the monitoring center can analyze it.

completeDesc.cn: “小黄塔”“红扇”“一帘青”……观测站已将这些植物的培育经验收录成册。
completeDesc.en: "Yellow Towerling", "Red Fan", "Green Curtain"... The monitoring center has compiled experiences for raising these plants into a book.

desc.cn: 蓄水站工作人员搭设了这处植物观察点，只为培养生命力更强的植物。请将其拍摄下来，以便学生们研究学习。
desc.en: Reservoir Station personnel have established this flora observation point to cultivate and raise more resilient plants. Please photograph this location for the disciples to study and learn from.

completeDesc.cn: 该生态点的水、植物、动物数量及分布一直受到较为严格的监控，这将为后续息壤扩散实验项目做好准备。
completeDesc.en: The population sizes and distribution of local flora and fauna, as well as the water quality of this eco-site, have been subject to constant monitoring. This will better prepare us for the subsequent Xiranite dispersion research project.

desc.cn: 栖云林地一直是观测站的定期监测目标之一，请将其现状拍摄下来，以供分析。
desc.en: Cloudrest Woods is one of the many target areas regularly observed by the monitoring center. Please photograph its current state for analysis.

completeDesc.cn: 虹霞穿雨，美不胜收。数据已完成收录。
completeDesc.en: The sight of a rainbow arching through the drizzle is beautiful indeed. Image data has been successfully archived.

desc.cn: 除去监测环境，观测站也需准备一些风景照，其主要用于修饰向宏科院本部发送的定期报告。
desc.en: The monitoring center must provide photographs of the natural landscape in addition to its regular job of environmental monitoring. These photos are primarily used to embellish the center's regular reports for the Hongshan Academy of Sciences.
